headline: Weekend Preview · October 16–18: Jailer 2 Opens On A ₹41.48 Crore Advance, Five New Films Land In 48 Hours, And Drishyam Finally Gets Tested
dek: Jailer 2 closed its day-one advance at ₹41.48 crore gross on 19.6 lakh tickets across 17,615 shows — the biggest Tamil pre-sale of the year — and passed ₹60 crore worldwide. We call ₹60 crore India net on opening day, band ₹54–67, and ₹188 crore across the extended Thursday-to-Sunday weekend; ₹200 crore needs day one at ₹64 crore. Then five new films land in 48 hours. Ranabaali's ₹86 lakh advance is 87% block seats — ₹11 lakh of genuine public pre-sale — while Nayi Naveli and Prahaar have not sold out a single show between 4,420 of them. Drishyam: The Conclusion gives up screens to all five and finally gets tested. Plus the Jailer 2 heat map state by state, our ₹260.30 crore national weekend chart, Hanuman Ansh's bands closing to within ₹6 crore of Drishyam's, Ramayana's US pre-sales opening onto an empty board with four different release dates listed, and the streaming, music and American charts.
